subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Modern life often moves fast underground.”?
options: The ancient wall reminded travelers that speed is not the only value beneath a city.
The ancient road reminded them that modern life is often built on layers of earlier footsteps.
In a city, a tree can be an umbrella, an air conditioner, and a quiet helper.
The Warm Wall shows that even quiet people may have something helpful to say.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Modern life often moves fast underground. The ancient wall reminded travelers that speed is not the only value beneath a city.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The ancient road reminded them that modern life is often built on layers of earlier footsteps.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「In a city, a tree can be an umbrella, an air conditioner, and a quiet helper.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The Warm Wall shows that even quiet people may have something helpful to say.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Modern life often moves fast underground. The ancient wall reminded travelers that speed is not the only value beneath a city.」，答案為「The ancient wall reminded travelers that speed is not the only value beneath a city.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The ancient wall reminded travelers that speed is not the only value beneath a city.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
